
 Usage: agentos web [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 The web app at http://127.0.0.1:7410/: a prebuilt copy for this release,
 optional. Install, update, remove, status.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ status   What the local service serves at /, and whether it matches this     │
│          agentos.                                                            │
│ install  Download this release's web app from GitHub, check its sha256, and  │
│          unpack it under the home.                                           │
│ update   Install or update the web app to match this agentos, unless you     │
│          said no or AGENTOS_NO_WEB=1.                                        │
│ remove   Remove the installed web app. The node, MCP and live views keep     │
│          working.                                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
